At Anchorage Digital, we are building the world’s most advanced digital asset platform for institutions to participate in crypto.
 
Anchorage Digital is a crypto platform that enables institutions to participate in digital assets through custody, staking, trading, governance, settlement, and the industry's leading security infrastructure. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the first federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital, and other offerings.
 
The company is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with its Series D valuation over $3 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on X @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn. 
With the evolving landscape of digital threats and an increasing volume of sophisticated attacks by malicious actors, we have a security policy mandating all new hires complete an in-person onboarding process - no exceptions. Security is our foundation and we prioritize physical identity verification and secure IT setup. While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. We believe that a laptop can be shipped, but our culture cannot.


The Protocols team is the back-end team at Anchorage Digital that works closest to the blockchain. We are responsible for developing cutting-edge digital assets on top of the latest blockchain technologies and working closely with product and design teams to build out DeFi, governance, and participation mechanisms with blockchains.
 
At Anchorage Digital, we want to support all the assets. This means there will always be a need to learn new blockchains, technologies and innovations, and integrate them into our ecosystem. With all existing and upcoming business lines, developing a scalable, reproducible, and reliable layer--that such business lines can use when interacting with the different blockchains--is critical. We are never "done," we can always do better! By joining Anchorage Digital, not only will you be a part of a top notch team, we also expect you to help the team grow as a whole. From your technical expertise and architecture skills, to mentoring teammates, we work as a team end to end.

You will:
• Deeply research new cryptoassets and integrate them into Anchorage Digital’s platform.
• Implement participatory features that clients need such as staking, governance, vesting, etc.
• Develop infrastructure that scales across all crypto-networks.
• Support assets through upgrades and monitor for network-wide issues.
• Contribute with and review code across the entire stack and engineering organization.
• Find the right balance between progress (i.e. shipping quickly) and perfection (i.e. measuring twice).
• Foster an efficient deterministic testing culture, with an emphasis on minimizing tech debt and bureaucracy.
• Influence architecture/product roadmap - have a seat at the table.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with everyone.
• Help scale the team.
• Work on the front lines of the blockchain/crypto movement and SecOps innovation.
• Ship code that will impact the global economy.
You may be a good fit for this role if:
• You have real world experience building complex distributed systems. We mostly use Go, however languages can be learned. We really care about your engineering skills more than any specific language or framework.
• You enjoy building services from scratch and supporting them over a meaningful period of time.
• You genuinely care about code quality and test infrastructure.
• You prioritize end-user experience and business value over “cool tech.”
• You have developed “computer science fundamentals”, i.e. concurrency, algorithms, and data structures (Formal CS degree NOT required).
• You self describe as some combination of the following: creative, humble, ambitious, detail oriented, hard working, trustworthy, eager to learn, methodical, action oriented, and tenacious.
Although not a requirement, bonus points if:
• You have experience with applied cryptography.
• You feel comfortable diving down the stack and into open source projects to root cause a bug.
• In your mind the word “crypto” stands for cryptography, not cryptocurrency.
• You read blockchain protocol white papers for fun, and stay up to date with the proliferation of cryptoasset innovations.
• You have a background in the finance industry.
Tech stack:
• Backend Tech: Go, C++, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Vault, GCP, AWS, and GraphQL.
• Engineering methodologies: Reverse uptime, cryptographically linked data models, tamper resistant ledgers, air gapped infrastructure, secure execution environments, repeatable builds, and infra-as-code.
About Anchorage Digital: Who we are
 
The Anchorage Village, what we call our team, brings together the brightest minds from platform security, financial services, and distributed ledger technology to provide the building blocks that empower institutions to safely participate in  the evolving digital asset ecosystem. As a diverse team of more than 600 members, we are united in one common goal: building the future of finance by providing the foundation upon which value moves safely in the new global economy.

description:
About the company
At Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.”
By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology.
With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber.
Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from Booking.com , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.
Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.
About the role
Remote in Europe, or hybrid in Barcelona, Dublin, London, or Palma.
Imagine making a technical decision today and seeing its impact on revenue in days.
You'll lead engineering for Pricing & Revenue, a core part of Nuitée's hotel booking infrastructure. This is where supplier connectivity, distribution, pricing, and monetisation come together, with engineering decisions directly affecting performance, competitiveness, and margin.
You'll own the technical direction, architecture, reliability, and delivery of the domain. You'll lead and grow a small engineering team, work closely with Product and Trading, and have the autonomy to decide how to solve problems without approval layers.
The technical challenge is central. A single hotel search can trigger synchronous queries across around 200 suppliers. We're now building more sophisticated trading capabilities, including a proper pricing engine and automated rebooking, to make better decisions about supply, pricing, and distribution at scale.
What makes it interesting for you
•
Build something important from scratch. We're developing a proper pricing engine and new trading capabilities on top of an established, revenue-generating platform.
•
Real technical ownership. You'll make architectural decisions, shape how the domain evolves, and see the commercial impact of your engineering choices.
•
You stay close to engineering. You'll lead, mentor, and hire engineers while remaining deeply involved in the systems, code, and technical decisions.
•
You can move fast. Small teams, little red tape, and the freedom to make decisions. You can identify a problem, make a change, and see its impact quickly.
Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre. This role comes with meaningful equity, so when we hit our next growth milestones, you get real upside in the company you’re helping build.
The kind of problems you'll work on
•
How do we build a pricing engine that balances supply, demand, competitiveness, and margin across a complex hotel marketplace?
•
How do we return competitive rates quickly when each hotel search can involve around 200 supplier connections, with different response times and reliability?
•
How do we improve hotel search availability, currently around 42%, while ensuring customers can actually fulfil their bookings?
•
How do we automate rebooking, first for our internal operations and eventually as a product our customers can use?
This role fits if you
•
Have led, mentored, and grown engineering teams while staying hands-on with architecture, code, and production problems.
•
Have built or improved marketplace, trading, or optimisation systems, with experience across both supply and demand.
•
Understand how pricing, inventory, distribution, and fulfilment interact in a marketplace.
•
Have strong Go experience and deep backend engineering expertise, including distributed systems, high-volume APIs, latency, concurrency, and reliability.
•
Can translate complex commercial problems into engineering decisions and build systems that deliver measurable outcomes.
•
Thrive in fast-moving environments where you're expected to take ownership and figure things out.
Experience with marketplaces involving real-world inventory, such as mobility, delivery, ecommerce, or travel, is particularly valuable.
Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You’ll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your work actually delivers.
If this sounds like your kind of role, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV.
Why Nuitee?
At Nuitée, we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.
• Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale.
• World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally.
• Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup.
• Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others

ABOUT ACTAI 

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. 

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 


ROLE

As a Backend Engineer, AI, you own the inference and orchestration layer that powers every AI interaction in the product. Your work sits between models and users, where latency, correctness, reliability, and cost directly impact real-world experience.

You will build and operate production systems that turn model capability into fast, stable, observable APIs used across mobile and desktop clients.

 


FOCUS

 - Build and operate backend systems that serve AI-powered features in production.

 - Design inference pipelines, orchestration layers, and service boundaries around models.

 - Own production concerns: monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response.

 - Optimize latency and throughput across inference, caching, batching, and streaming.

 


IDEAL EXPERIENCES

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals in production environments.

 - Experience running high-throughput, low-latency services.

 - Familiarity with AI inference patterns (LLMs, embeddings, multimodal).

 - Comfortable debugging distributed systems under load.

 - Bias toward shipping and learning from production behavior.

 


OUTCOMES

 - Backend systems run reliably at scale, handling production AI traffic with low latency and high throughput.

 - APIs are stable, clear, and support seamless integration with frontend and ML systems.

 - Production incidents are quickly detected, diagnosed, and resolved, minimizing user impact.

 - Iterative improvements based on real usage continuously increase system performance and reliability.

 


TECH STACK

 - Python

 - NodeJs

 - Pytorch

 - OpenAI / Anthropic / open-source LLMs

 - SQl & noSQL

 - Kubernetes

 - Docker

 


HOW WE WORK

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning.  Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

ABOUT US

Pliant is a modular B2B payments platform that combines commercial card issuing, payment accounts, FX, and spend management in one system — adapting to existing setups rather than requiring customers to replace them.

Businesses across industries such as travel, e-commerce, and insurance use Pliant to manage complex payment workflows with cards, backed by credit lines Pliant underwrites itself.

Fintechs and software platforms embed Pliant's payment infrastructure into their own products, from API-based Cards-as-a-Service to fully white-label solutions. Banks use Pliant's Card & Spend OS, the customer-facing interface, on their own infrastructure to run card programs.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Berlin, Pliant serves 5,000+ businesses and 40+ partners across Europe and the United States. A principal member of Visa and Mastercard, Pliant issues commercial cards in 13 currencies across 32 countries — under its own European e-money license and with licensed partners in the UK and US.

Learn more at  http://www.getpliant.com/www.getpliant.com http://www.getpliant.com



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're seeking an Engineering Manager - Developer Experience (m/f/d) to define and lead a brand-new platform engineering team focused on Developer Experience, the discipline where Pliant ensures every engineer is productive from day one and autonomous from day two.

This is a founding role. You will be the first hire on the team, which means you get to define what great looks like before hiring the engineers to build it alongside you. You will own the golden path that product teams actually use, CI/CD integrations engineers can modify without raising a ticket, self-service environment provisioning, and a Service Registry as the canonical source of truth for everything running on Kubernetes. Initially, you will be heavily hands-on, coding alongside your team, reviewing designs, and making architectural calls. The expectation is that hands-on involvement remains high as the team is built out, with leadership responsibilities growing in parallel as the team matures.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - You use AI-assisted coding tools every day. Claude Code, Cursor, or something equivalent. Not occasionally. You know how to coach engineers who haven't made the shift yet, and you're the one who sets the bar for how the team uses them. Pliant is investing heavily in AI tooling and your team will own the company's AI harness so you need to be its most credible user.

 - Own the golden path: Build and maintain deployment templates, opinionated CI/CD patterns on top of our Kubernetes cluster APIs, production readiness checklists, and onboarding flows that get a new service to production without filing a support ticket.

 - Own developer satisfaction as a metric: Track golden path adoption rate, deployment lead time, and time-to-first-deploy for new services. When engineers route around the platform, that is your problem to diagnose and fix.

 - Standardise AI-assisted development tooling: Lead the team building the AI harness that standardises the usage of assisted development tools across the company, including Claude Code, Cursor, and others.

 - Build the team from zero: Own hiring, culture, and the technical bar from the very first hire. The people you bring in first define what this team becomes, and you know that.



WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 4+ years of software development experience with Python, including 2+ years in leadership/management. Go experience is a strong plus.

 - Hands-on experience building CI/CD systems, internal developer portals, or golden paths, with enough codebase familiarity to still be useful. You can read a Helm chart, write a Kubernetes admission webhook, and debug a GitHub Actions runner issue. You do not need to be the fastest IC on the team, but engineers need to trust your technical calls.

 - Deep experience with Kubernetes-based platforms specifically, including cluster APIs, namespaces, RBAC, admission control, and deployment patterns well enough to make informed decisions.

 - A product mindset for internal tooling. The failure mode for DX teams is building things that get bypassed. You have shipped something internal that people chose over the workaround.

 - Experience hiring engineers, including at least one hire that taught you something. Building a team from scratch means the first few hires matter more than usual.

 - Security-first thinking that shows up in the design, not just the vocabulary. You know what "shift left" means and you practice it.

 - Fintech or regulated-environment experience is a genuine advantage. We operate under PCI DSS and SOC2.

 - The product teams run Java and Kotlin, and they'll come to you when something breaks. You don't need to write Java. You do need to read a stack trace, follow a build log, and tell a configuration issue from a code bug. If you've never touched a JVM that's fine as long as you’re willing to learn

 - Fluent in English



THE FIRST YEAR 

 - The first few months are mostly discovery and hiring. You are learning where the friction actually is, writing a team charter, interviewing candidates, and probably fixing at least one thing that has been annoying everyone for longer than it should have.

 - By mid-year the team has a few engineers on board and a version of the golden path that is meaningfully better than what existed before.

 - By year one the Service Registry is live, golden path adoption is measurable, and your team has a defined roadmap it owns.

 - Tech Stack: Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Spacelift, GitHub Actions, Datadog.

 - We are in the middle of an ECS-to-Kubernetes migration, so there is real new ground to cover from day one.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

 - The opportunity to work in a growing team with big responsibilities that thrives on a strong exchange of knowledge and excellence

 - Attractive remuneration

 - Your choice of preferred OS, Windows or Mac

 - Flat hierarchy and transparent communication in a relax

About the role

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Platform team. This is a high-impact, high-trust role at the center of our Cloud product, combining people leadership, technical direction, product thinking, and operational ownership while maintaining the reliability customers expect.

You’ll work hand-in-hand with Product, Infrastructure, Security, Support, and engineering teams across ClickHouse.

This role goes beyond engineering leadership. Together with your team, you’ll help shape how new products and teams will integrate and deploy their applications in ClickHouse Cloud.

What You’ll Do

 - Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team - recruit to a high bar, set crisp expectations, give direct feedback and career development, and manage performance — while fostering a healthy, inclusive environment built on empathy, psychological safety, trust, and a high technical bar.

 - Own outcomes across the platform surface: API gateways and API standards, shared platform services (event bus, notifications, feature flags, websockets, audit records), deployment and infrastructure patterns, CI and testing, local developer experience, disaster recovery, and Control Plane observability.

 - Guide architecture and help senior engineers make explicit, sound tradeoffs. land cross-cutting migrations, deprecations, and contract changes across teams without stalling product delivery.

 - 8+ years in software engineering and 3+ years managing software engineers with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong talent.

 - Experience leading a platform or infrastructure team whose customers are other engineering teams — you've driven adoption and cross-org migrations through influence and good tooling rather than mandate.

 - Experience leading distributed global teams, fostering an inclusive and autonomous culture, and creating clarity across time zones.

ABOUT VOODOO

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.



This position is ideally Paris-based.




TEAM

For this position, you will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become.

You will be part of the team building Castle Busters, a turn-based multiplayer game, working alongside its client engineers and game designers as a full member of the game team. You will be part of a small group owning the backend that this game needs as its requirements become more specific and demanding.

You’ll also be plugged into Voodoo's shared gaming backend platform - the same architecture and patterns that power titles like Mob Control and Block Jam 3D - building on it and contributing back, in close collaboration with the wider backend team. You get the focus and ownership of a dedicated game engineer with the leverage and support of a battle-tested platform behind you.

This is a pivotal hire: Castle Busters is moving towards competitive multiplayer, which means moving game logic from the client to the server. You will be central to that transition.






ROLE

You will design and build the server-side foundation that takes Castle Busters from a client-authoritative game to a competitive, server-validated one. The current game computes everything on the device - progression, economy, and match outcomes alike, which won't hold up for competitive PvP. Your job is to change that.

Working closely with client developers and game designers from feature design through delivery, validation and iteration, you will:

 - Build server-side validation for the metagame - currency, card upgrades, chest opens, and progression - staged by risk, replicating economy and reward logic on the server.

 - Move toward server authority for competitive features, where game state lives in one place and can be trusted.

 - Design APIs and player-state management that the Unity client integrates against, and help shape how client and server split responsibilities.

The responsibilities are cross-functional, ranging from infrastructure, API design & coding all the way to client-side integration (we are using Golang).

To succeed in this role, you will need to have passion for everything you do. You love to write code that scales to millions of users, are skilled at requirements gathering, champion new tech initiatives & leverage existing solutions.




PROFILE

 - 7+ years of backend development experience

 - Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals

 - Extreme fluency in Golang (At least 1 year in a professional environment)

 - Mastery of SQL and NoSQL

 - Background in high-scale systems

 - Understanding of Unix-like environments

 - AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work

 - Experience working in cross-functional agile teams

 - Strong analytical skills with a track record of solving complex problems related to scalability, performance, and integration in high-stakes environments.

 - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of influencing teams and interfacing effectively with various stakeholders.

 - Ability to be self sufficient and work autonomously.

 - A deep interest in game development is a plus.




BENEFITS

 - Best-in-class compensation

 - Other benefits according to the country you reside

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.






THE ROLE

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.



This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.



You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

 - Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

 - Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

 - Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

 - Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

 - Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

 - Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

 - Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

 - Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

 - Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

 - Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

 - Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

 - Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

 - Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

 - Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

 - Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

 - Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

 - Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

 - Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

 - Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.




THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

 - People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

 - Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

 - Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

 - Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

 - People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

 - Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.




THE BAR

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.



A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.



You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.





LOCATION 

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.





LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.





INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:
ABOUT DOIT

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.   

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.  

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.




THE ROLE

Doit builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.



The Lead Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

 - Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

 - Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

 - Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

 - Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

 - Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

 - Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

 

What We're Looking For

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

 - Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

 - Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

 - Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

 - Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

 - Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

 


LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid)
About the Department
Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.
About the Team
We build the infrastructure that makes the web Payable , powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.
Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the Agentic Internet . As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We build tools that make the new internet payable by giving our users the ability to monetize access to their content, data, services, products, and outcomes across the Internet, regardless of where they are hosted.
Building these capabilities requires solving complex engineering problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, usage metering, outcome verification, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols (such as x402, WBA, ACP, and UCP). We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale.
We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to serve as an expert and technical leader on our Agentic Commerce team. In this role, you will define the architecture, build core systems, and establish technical standards powering machine-to-machine payments, metering, and monetization across Cloudflare's network.
As a Senior Engineer, your impact extends beyond individual features. You will shape product and engineering roadmaps by partnering directly with customers, product managers, and across Cloudflare teams. You will write architectural specs that guide engineers inside and outside the team, build systems that reduce complexity for others, and lead complex incident responses. You will be a prime reviewer for large systems, define core product KPIs, and mentor engineers across the organization to elevate our collective engineering practice.

description:
About Us
At BGBx , we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges.
Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day.
If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx.
Position Overview
The Agent Fleet Architect will build the operating system for an AI-native organization.
We are looking for someone who sees AI differently: not as a collection of copilots, not as isolated automations, and not as a graveyard of bots. You see systems. Agents talking to agents. Tools exposing capabilities. Context flowing across the organization. Humans stepping in where they add value. Work moving automatically from trigger to outcome. You want to build the layer that makes all of this work together.
The mission
We become an AI-native organization , not a company that happens to use AI. A company designed around humans, agents and software systems working together. Our engineering teams build the foundations: APIs, data, permissions, MCPs, CLIs, knowledge, tools and reliable internal capabilities. They make the organization understandable and accessible to machines . You make it actionable . You take those capabilities and turn them into agents, fleets and workflows that actually get work done. Engineering builds the rails. You make the trains move.
You build fleets, not bots
One agent is interesting, but a hundred disconnected agents are chaos. The real opportunity is in designing how they work together.
You think about:
• Who does what, and in what order?
• What does each agent need to know?
• Which model, agent, human or tool should handle the next step?
• How does work move without losing context?
• How do we build something once and make it available everywhere?
• What should persist, where, and for whom?
• What is each agent allowed to know and do?
• How do we know what happened when something goes wrong?
• Human-in-the-loop. Where do people add judgment instead of friction?
You are designing the connective tissue of the organization.
You care about the workflow
You are not impressed because an agent can perform one clever task.
You want the whole loop:
• A signal appears.
• An agent understands it.
• It gathers the right context.
• It calls the right tools.
• It delegates part of the job.
• Another agent picks it up.
• A human approves something important.
• A system gets updated.
• Slack gets notified.
• The next action happens automatically.
• The loop closes.
That is what you care about. Not the demo. The workflow.
Deep engineering underneath. Ridiculous speed on top.
You believe great engineering and low-code belong together. Deep engineering teams should not spend their lives building every individual automation, they should build powerful primitives : APIs. MCP servers & CLIs. Identity. Permissions. Structured data. Reusable tools. Reliable infrastructure. Then builders should be able to combine those primitives into powerful agents and workflows at extraordinary speed.
You understand why a low-code agent sitting on top of excellent engineering infrastructure can be more valuable than another bespoke application living in isolation. You want engineering to make more of the organization programmable . Then you want to unleash it.
You understand the technology
• You are not a no-code tourist.
• You have written code.
• You understand software systems.
• You can read an API spec.
• You know what an OAuth flow is doing.
• You can inspect a payload.
• You understand webhooks, schemas, databases and data structures.
• You can trace why an integration broke.
• You can write some code when code is the right answer.
• And, importantly, you know when it isn't.
• Your superpower is knowing when to:
• code it
• configure it
• connect it
• delegate it
• or not build it at all
You are technical enough to work deeply with engineering without needing to turn every idea into an engineering project.
Your natural habitat
• MCP.
• A2A.
• Tool calling.
• Agent routing.
• Agent memory.
• Multi-agent orchestration.
• OpenClaw.
• Grok bots.
• LS Fleet.
• CrewAI.
• Slack automations.
• APIs.
• Webooks.
• Low-code platforms.
Whatever appeared three weeks ago that might make all of this 10x better. The exact stack will change. That does not bother you. You are interested in the architecture underneath it.
You think in systems
You open a company and see a graph.
• People.
• Knowledge.
• Tools.
• Agents.
• Permissions.
• Data.
• Systems.
• Actions.
• Workflows.
And connections that should exist but don't.
You instinctively believe in:
• systems over silos
• workflows over features
• capabilities over applications
• fleets over bots
• outcomes over demos
You see two systems that cannot talk to each other and it physically annoys you.
You probably can't help yourself
• You don't need someone to tell you AI agents are going to matter.
• You are already building with them.
• You see a new model and immediately wonder what you can connect it to.
• You sit through a manual process and redesign it in your head before the meeting ends.
• You have prototypes nobody asked for.
• You have diagrams that explain how six systems should really be one system.
• You see 1,000 opportunities and your main problem is deciding which one to build first.
• You have the curiosity of a hacker.
• The judgment of someone who understands engineering.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.
What You Will Be Doing:
• Leveraging your distributed systems expertise to build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
• Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.

• You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.

Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Ruby Labs, we are looking for a Senior Desktop Engineer to own and drive a new cross-platform desktop product from first commit to production.

This is a high-ownership role with an unusually deep systems component. The application is not a wrapped web app: it captures system and microphone audio in real time, renders an always-on-top overlay across the user's workspace, registers global shortcuts, and integrates with the operating system at a level that requires native code on both macOS and Windows.

Our architecture is Electron for the application and UI layer, with native modules and helper processes in Swift and C++ where the platform requires it. You will own that boundary, deciding what belongs in TypeScript, what belongs in native code, and making the two halves behave as one reliable product.

You will also own everything that happens after the build: code signing, notarization, entitlements, permission onboarding, auto-update, and crash reporting. On this product, those are not an afterthought; they are a significant share of the engineering work, and getting them wrong is what stops users from ever running the app.

You will operate as the senior technical voice for desktop within your team, setting the engineering standard for the platform.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES





DESKTOP APPLICATION & ENGINEERING QUALITY

 - Own the Electron architecture end to end — main, renderer and helper processes, IPC design, context isolation, process lifecycle — and deliver major features within agreed timelines.

 - Build transparent, frameless, always-on-top overlay windows that behave correctly across full-screen spaces, multiple displays and mixed-DPI setups, alongside global shortcuts, tray presence and low-latency UI under continuous background load.

 - Design a clean platform abstraction in TypeScript so the macOS and Windows implementations stay isolated and independently testable, and write idiomatic Swift and C++ in the native layer.

 - Keep the product reliable: defensive handling of unstable platform APIs, tests and code reviews, performance, memory and battery budgets, and remediation of security-review and penetration-test findings within agreed severity SLAs.


NATIVE PLATFORM INTEGRATION

 - Build and maintain the native layer: Node addons (N-API / node-addon-api) and out-of-process helpers in Swift and C++.

 - Implement real-time system audio capture — Core Audio process taps and ScreenCaptureKit on macOS, WASAPI loopback on Windows — including device change handling, format negotiation and graceful recovery from driver-level failures.

 - Integrate with the Accessibility API (AXUIElement) on macOS and UI Automation on Windows to read application context reliably.

 - Own the IPC protocol and lifecycle between Electron and the native helpers, and keep the application working as Apple and Microsoft change their platforms.


DISTRIBUTION, PERMISSIONS & RELEASE RELIABILITY

 - Own code signing and notarization on macOS — hardened runtime, entitlements, nested binary signing, provisioning profiles — and Authenticode signing, SmartScreen reputation and antivirus false positives on Windows.

 - Design the permission onboarding flow — microphone, system audio, screen recording, accessibility — so that grant rates stay high and failure states are recoverable.

 - Build and maintain the release pipeline: CI matrix builds, signing from CI with HSM-backed certificates, auto-update, staged rollout and rollback.

 - Own crash reporting and production telemetry for the desktop client, and act on what it tells you.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 6+ years of software engineering experience, including production-grade TypeScript/Node.js.

 - 3+ years building and shipping Electron applications to real end users, not internal tools or proofs of concept.

 - Hands-on native macOS development in Swift and/or Objective-C, with AppKit and at least one system-level framework such as Core Audio, AVFoundation, ScreenCaptureKit, or the Accessibility API.

 - Practical experience writing native Node addons (N-API / node-addon-api) or bundling and communicating with out-of-process native helpers.

 - Demonstrated experience with macOS code signing, notarization, entitlements, and the TCC permission model — you have debugged a rejected notarization and know how to read the log.

 - Working knowledge of the Windows desktop platform: Win32 APIs, Authenticode signing, and the practical realities of SmartScreen and antivirus reputation.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.
What You’ll Build

• Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users

Requirements
Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.
Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements
• 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
• Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
• Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
• Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
• Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
• Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
• Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.
Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)
• Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
• Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
• Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
• Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
• Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.
The Kind of Person We’re Looking For
Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:
Missionary, Not Mercenary
You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.
Builder, Not a Bystander

ABOUT DOIT

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.   

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.  

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.




THE ROLE

Doit builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Lead Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

 - Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

 - Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

 - Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

 - Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

 - Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

 - Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

 

What We're Looking For

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

 - Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

 - Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

 - Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

 - Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

 - Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

 


LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.   

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.  

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.




THE ROLE

Doit builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.



The Staff Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

 - Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

 - Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

 - Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

 - Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

 - Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

 - Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

 

What We're Looking For

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

 - Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

 - Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

 - Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

 - Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

 - Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

 


LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

ABOUT DOIT

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.   

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.  

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 


THE ROLE

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.  



This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.  



You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

 - Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

 - Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

 - Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

 - Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

 - Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

 - Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

 - Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

 - Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

 - Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

 - Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

 - Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

 - Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

 - Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

 - Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

 - Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

 - Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

 - Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

 - Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

 - Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.




THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

 - Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

 - Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

 - Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

 - People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

 - Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.




THE BAR

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

 You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.




LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

 3. CEO / final round

description:
ABOUT DOIT

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.   

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.  

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.



This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.



You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

 - Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

 - Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

 - Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

 - Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

 - Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

 - Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

 - Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

 - Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

 - Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

 - Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

 - Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.






WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

 - Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

 - Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

 - Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

 - Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

 - Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

 - Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

 - Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

 - Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.






THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

 - People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

 - Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

 - Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

 - Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

 - People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

 - Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.






THE BAR

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.



A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.



You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.





LOCATION 

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.





LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.





INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.  



You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

 - Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

 - Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

 - Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

 - Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

 - Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

 - Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

 - Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

 - Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

 - Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

 - Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

 - Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

 - Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

 - Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

 - Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

 - Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

 - Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

 - Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

 - Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

 - Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.




THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

 - Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

 - Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

 - Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

 - People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

 - Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.




THE BAR

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

 You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.




LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 3. CEO / final round

About the Role
As a Staff Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will own the technical direction of Alpaca's streaming platform - our Redpanda-based event backbone and the user-facing streaming infrastructure. Platform also owns Authentication, Developer Experience and QA, and AI-Native Engineering. Streaming is roughly two-thirds of the job and where we expect you to become the deepest engineer in the company; across the other three you review the designs, hold an informed opinion, and lead the work where they meet streaming.
This is a Staff role, so we are hiring for direction as much as delivery - the engineer who decides what the streaming platform looks like in two years, writes the RFC that gets three teams to agree, and then builds the hard part. We own client-facing and internal services, maintain shared libraries nearly every team depends on, and manage our own deployments. • Shape AuthN/AuthZ direction across Alpaca and lead the work where identity meets streaming: authorizing real-time subscriptions, token lifecycle on long-lived connections, multi-tenant isolation
