You will work directly with operational experts, the client’s technology partners and our engineers, challenge assumptions constructively, and carry the technical solution from discovery through implementation and evaluation.




HOW YOU WILL WORK

You own the technical approach, engineering plan, implementation quality and evidence of readiness. You partner with the engagement Principal, who owns the integrated delivery plan, commercial scope and client commitments. You provide feasibility assessments before commitments are made and escalate unresolved dependencies or scope changes with options and their impact.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN

1. Establish an evidence-based technical baseline

 - Inspect the code, infrastructure, APIs and operator workflows before estimating the build.

 - Translate discovery into concise specifications with inputs, outputs, exclusions, acceptance tests and source references.

 - Distinguish confirmed requirements from analyst recommendations and assumptions.

 - Resolve contradictions with the appropriate owner. Do not implement them silently.

2. Make integration work early

 - Build and review critical components, guide engineers and prove a thin end-to-end path in the client’s test environment: receive a request, retrieve operational data, produce a recommendation, obtain approval and perform the agreed system handoff.

 - Verify API access, write capabilities, event contracts and error paths. Do not treat documentation or isolated components as proof of readiness.

3. Make rules and knowledge maintainable

 - Design a clear separation between operational facts, business policies and software logic.

 - Work with named business owners to define rule precedence, exceptions, validation and approval.

 - Keep draft or inferred rules separate from approved rules.

 - Support versioned updates without a software release, with historical replay, traceable approval and rollback.

 - Use grounded reasoning and human escalation where rules do not resolve a case.

4. Own engineering quality and evaluation

 - Review and test code, including AI-generated code, against the agreed architecture.

 - Establish automated CI checks, integration tests and representative operational cases.

 - Track the exact application, rule and data versions evaluated.

 - Implement decision logs, monitoring, access controls and failure recovery.

 - Define test-readiness evidence and agree workflow-quality, latency and operating-cost measures with the team and client.

5. Keep technical decisions and progress clear

 - Maintain a concise architecture and decision record that shows what works, what remains and why.

 - Raise blockers early with evidence, an owner, a decision needed and delivery impact.

 - Propose simpler alternatives and update estimates when assumptions change.

 - Demonstrate working increments, and clearly distinguish prototypes from integrated functionality.

 - Leave the team with maintainable code, documentation and a practical handover.




WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

 - Before build commitments: a reviewed technical baseline, verified critical dependencies and explicit assumptions behind the estimate.

 - During delivery: a working end-to-end increment, automated tests running in CI, and demonstrated progress against agreed acceptance cases.

 - For rule changes: a named business approver, a versioned baseline and recorded replay results before promotion.

 - At evaluation: reproducible results, decision traces and documented limitations that support the agreed Go/No-Go decision, not just a successful demo.

Specific targets will be agreed after the baseline is established. You will stay involved from the initial working sessions through delivery and evaluation.

description:
WHY SDK ENGINEERING AT LANGFUSE


YOUR WORK WILL HAVE AN OUTSIZED IMPACT.

Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month. When you ship a new integration or improve SDK performance, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels. Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible.

The SDK is often the very first thing a developer touches when they try Langfuse, so your work directly shapes their first impression.

You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM-applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers in the world and that leverage Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible SDK experience and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

 


YOU WILL GROW AT LANGFUSE BY

 - Owning our SDKs. We maintain SDKs in Python and TypeScript both built on OpenTelemetry. You'll be responsible for their reliability, performance, and developer experience. These SDKs run inside our users' production systems, which means they must never fail, must have minimal impact on CPU and memory, and must work flawlessly across every environment — from serverless functions to long-running agent loops. You'll think deeply about the exposed interfaces, error handling, batching, async flushing, and graceful degradation.

 - Designing APIs that developers love. How are functions named, how are parameters structured, how are breaking changes communicated, how does the documentation read? Developer experience is a core differentiator for Langfuse and you'll own every detail of it. When we shipped the Python SDK v3 https://langfuse.com/changelog/2025-06-05-python-sdk-v3-generally-available and TypeScript SDK v4 https://langfuse.com/changelog/2025-08-28-typescript-sdk-v4-ga, both were full rewrites on OpenTelemetry — that's the kind of thoughtful, high-impact SDK work you'll lead. Apart from tracing, we also support core workflows of engineers building with LLMs with our SDKs, see our Experiment Runner SDK https://langfuse.com/docs/evaluation/experiments/experiments-via-sdk#experiment-runner-sdk for example.

 - Integrating with every major AI framework: Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You'll maintain these integrations, ensure new Langfuse features are supported across all of them, and add new integrations as the ecosystem evolves. When a new framework gains traction, you'll be among the first to instrument it.

 - Maintaining our OpenTelemetry endpoint: some users send traces directly to our OTLP endpoint https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otlp/ instead of using our SDKs. You'll ensure this path is robust, well-documented, and supports the full range of Langfuse features. This also extends our language support to Java, Go, and any language with an OpenTelemetry SDK. You can work with the OpenTelemetry community to steer the GenAI conventions.

 - Writing public documentation: you'll own the SDK docs, integration guides, and migration paths. At Langfuse, docs are part of our core product. When you ship a new SDK version or integration, the docs ship with it.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong engineer who gets excited about developer experience, API design, and writing code that runs reliably in other people's production systems

 - Experience building or maintaining SDKs, client libraries, or developer tools — ideally in Python and/or TypeScript

 - Deep understanding of performance: you know how to profile, benchmark, and minimize CPU/memory overhead in hot paths

 - Someone who can  manage projects themselves — you know how to develop strong conviction about what to build and how to ship it

 - Thoughtful about versioning, backwards compatibility, and migration paths

 - Interest in open source software and genuine excitement about talking to developers about their integration challenges

 - Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

 - CS or quantitative degree preferred

 

Bonus points:

 - Experience with OpenTelemetry internals or observability instrumentation

 - Former founder or early startup experience

 - Contributions to popular open source SDKs or developer tools

 - ML/AI background or familiarity with the LLM framework ecosystem

 

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply.

 


LEARN MORE ABOUT

About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: London or Lisbon
About the Department
Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.
About the Team
We build the infrastructure that makes the web Payable , powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.
Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the Agentic Internet . As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We are building tools that help make the new internet payable by giving our users the ability to take control over how AI agents pay for resources across the Internet.
Building these capabilities requires solving problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols. We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale. We’re looking for someone excited to deliver products so domain owners can control this experience, while identifying the problems Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to solve next.
We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.
About the role
We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across Agentic Commerce.
You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that power machine-to-machine payments and monetization, such as our Monetization Gateway . You will partner closely with Product Management and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions around payment rails and cryptographic auth, ask the right questions when something is going wrong, and step into a technical problem when the situation calls for it.
At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.
This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.
What you'll do
• Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across high-throughput payment pipelines, agent authentication, and web-scale commerce architecture.
• Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.
• Lead the development of agentic payment systems leveraging emerging open standards (x402, Web Bot Auth, ACP, UCP) to enable low-latency, machine-to-machine micropayments.
• Lead the engineering behind usage metering, pricing definition engines, outcome verification, and revenue attribution models tailored for agentic workflows.
• Build capabilities that give businesses granular visibility and control over their agent-generated revenue streams.
• Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.
• Bridge mainstream and decentralized tech, interfacing with blockchain teams while keeping execution focused on mainstream, high-throughput web and fiat commerce rails.
• Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.
• Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, cryptographic security, and long-term reliability.
• Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.

Most complex technical challenges in Imunify360 go beyond individual squads. A single detection change can impact the scanner, agent, UI, reputation backend, and release process. While squad leads own delivery within their teams, the Staff Engineer ensures technical alignment across the product.
As a Staff Engineer, you'll be a hands-on technical leader working across the entire product , focusing on the most critical and high-impact challenges as priorities evolve. You'll drive technical decisions, improve architecture, establish engineering standards, and help teams build sustainable solutions.
This is an individual contributor role , without direct people management responsibilities. You'll remain actively involved in development, spending approximately 30–50% of your time writing production code , rather than focusing solely on architectural design.
While deep expertise in a particular area is valued, this role requires the flexibility to work across different components, collaborate with multiple squads, and tackle challenges wherever your expertise can make the greatest impact.
What you will own
Architecture and technical direction
• Own the end-to-end architecture of Imunify360 as a product: agent ↔ server ↔ cloud backends, data flows, and the contracts between them.
• Write and drive ADRs and RFCs for cross-squad changes. Run the Wed/Fri architecture sync together with the Technical Director.
• Keep a living tech-debt and risk register (security / compliance / uptime) with owners and dates, and get the top items funded on the roadmap.
Hard cross-cutting problems (examples of what lands on your desk)
• Agent resource footprint on dense shared hosts: CPU, memory and I/O budgets for scanning, file monitoring (inotify/fanotify) and WAF, measured on real kernels, not benchmarks from elsewhere.
• Detection pipeline quality: false positive / false negative rates, signature and ML model rollout with staged gates and rollback.
• Upgrade and release safety across a large, heterogeneous fleet (CentOS/AlmaLinux/CloudLinux/Ubuntu, multiple control panels, old kernels).
• Backend scale and cost of reputation, ThreatIntel and telemetry services.
• Migrating hot paths from Python to Go/Rust where the data shows it pays off, and saying no where it doesn't.
Engineering standards
• Set the bar for design reviews, code review, testing strategy, observability (Prometheus/Grafana/Sentry) and secure SDLC (OWASP ASVS, CIS Benchmarks as relevant).
• Lead or co-lead SEV1/SEV2 incidents when the cause is unclear or cross-squad; make sure the blameless post-mortem ships within 24 h and its actions get closed.
• Drive the AI-augmented SDLC in practice: show what good agentic coding looks like (prompt specificity, context provision, review quality, tool boundaries) on real changes, not slides.
People multiplier (no direct reports)
• Mentor senior engineers and squad leads toward staff-level scope.
• Act as the technical bar-raiser in hiring loops for senior and lead roles.
• Be the engineering voice in product and sales discussions: estimates, feasibility, and no dated customer commitment without a written squad-lead estimate.
Key Milestones
• 30 days: Shipped at least one non-trivial change to production. Can explain the full request path from agent to backend. Has a personal list of top 10 technical risks.
• 90 days: Owns one cross-squad initiative with an approved ADR, a measured baseline, and a staged rollout plan. Published risk register reviewed in arch sync.
• 6 months: That initiative is in production with before/after metrics. At least one engineering standard (e.g. release gating, agent perf budget, design review template) is adopted by 3+ squads.
• 12 months: Recognized by squad leads as the default escalation point for cross-cutting technical decisions. At least one senior engineer grown into broader scope with your mentorship.
Requirements
Must have
• 10+ years building and operating production software, with 3+ years in a Staff/Principal/Tech Lead scope spanning several teams.
• Strong production experience in Python and at least one of Go or Rust .
• Deep Linux internals : processes, filesystems, networking, kernel interfaces (inotify/fanotify, eBPF or similar), packaging (RPM/DEB), systemd.
• Track record of designing and running distributed systems at scale: async backends, queues, databases, caching, failure modes.
• You have owned systems that run on customer machines (agents, daemons, on-prem software) and know what upgrade safety, backward compatibility and resource budgets mean there.
• Security mindset: threat modeling, secure coding, handling of untrusted input (files, HTTP traffic, user content).
• Writes clear, short technical documents and drives decisions in async, remote teams across time zo

Job Description
Clear Street is modernizing the brokerage ecosystem. Founded in 2018, Clear Street is a diversified financial services firm replacing the legacy infrastructure used across capital markets.
We started from scratch by building a completely cloud-native clearing and custody system designed for today's complex, global market. Our platform is fully integrated with central clearing houses and exchanges to support billions in trading volume per day. We've agonized about our data model abstractions, created horizontal scalability, and crafted thoughtful APIs. All so we can provide a best-in-class experience for our clients.
By combining highly-skilled product and engineering talent with seasoned finance professionals, we're building the essentials to compete in today's fast-paced markets.
The Team:
The mission of the Clear Street Active team is to provide best execution for every asset class in every market. Active is building a new, state-of-the-art, cloud-based trading platform giving high-performance traders access to liquidity venues across multiple asset classes, cutting-edge charting, and sophisticated order handling.
The Active Data team owns how the business understands itself, and increasingly how it decides what to do next. Data flows into our warehouse from ad platforms, product analytics, CRM and support systems, and the brokerage's own systems. It flows back out to the platforms that message our customers, bid for new ones, and manage relationships with them. Every hop is a place where data can be duplicated, delayed, or quietly redefined, and an error that leaves the warehouse does not stay a reporting problem. It spends ad budget on the wrong people, sends a customer the wrong message, or misstates a regulated number. Moving data is table stakes. Keeping it true as it travels is the problem this role owns. It is a small team with a wide surface area, and we are scaling it as the platform grows toward tens of thousands of accounts.
The Role:
Three areas of the business depend on this role, and you will own the data for all of them:
• Growth. Bring in spend, clicks, and conversions from every paid, affiliate, and organic channel, reconcile them against our own records, and send funded-account outcomes back to the ad platforms, so bidding optimizes for customers who actually fund and trade.
• Lifecycle and the user journey. Resolve each customer's identity from a first anonymous visit through sign-up, KYC, funding, and first trade, and keep lifecycle messaging, CRM, and support systems in step with what actually happened.
• Brokerage data. Model account opening, KYC, funding and transfers, and trading from the platform's own systems, with the precision a regulated broker-dealer needs.
Across all three, you will:
• Own data integrity in both directions. Prove that every feed arrived complete and on time, and that every outbound sync landed what it should. A duplicated conversion inflates ad spend, a stale attribute sends the wrong message, and a broken join misstates funded accounts to leadership.
• Own the warehouse layers in dbt: raw landing, staged and identity-resolved models, and the curated models that analysts, data scientists, dashboards, and internal AI agents read from. Every model has a declared grain and tests.
• Establish data contracts with product engineering and with the owners of the platforms we depend on, so an upstream change is caught at the boundary instead of silently nulling a field three models downstream. You will define these rather than inherit them.
• Own governance: role-based access, PII masking, retention, and auditability, including self-serve tools that do not become a way around permissions.
• Choose deliberately between batch, change-data-capture, and streaming, based on what each consumer actually needs.
• Partner with Marketing, Product, and Operations to get the events and fields the business needs captured. This role is measured on whether the business's numbers are right and on time, not on pipelines delivered.
What We Value:
• Engineers measured on whether the numbers are right, not on what was shipped
• Very high agency. Much of the work here begins before the requirement is clear: the source has no documentation, the field you need was never captured, and the team that owns it is busy shipping. We need someone who chases a dependency into another team and ships something reliable without a spec.
• Skepticism about data, including your own pipelines. Check grain, joins, and completeness before you trust a number.
• A preference for boring, observable systems over clever ones
• Clear communication with non-engineers: able to explain to a marketer why yesterday's number moved, and to negotiate a schema change with a product team the same afternoon
• Pragmatism: ship the version that works now, and improve it deliberately rather than waiting for the ideal one
Requirements:
• Minimum five years in data engineering or analytics engineering, with production pipelines you were on the hook for when they broke
• Deep proficiency in SQL and Python, and production experience with dbt in a layered warehouse: raw, staged, and curated models with a declared grain, tests, and incremental builds
• Hands-on experience bringing in third-party and application data through managed connectors, event pipelines, and change-data-capture, and handling what goes wrong with each: schema drift, resyncs, duplicates, and late or missing records
• Experience sending data back out, through reverse ETL, audiences, or conversion feeds, and owning its correctness after it leaves the warehouse
• Data quality in practice: reconciliation against systems of record, freshness and volume monitoring, and the fix that stops an incident from recurring
• Data governance in practice: role-based access, PII masking, retention, and an audit trail you could show a regulator
• Familiarity with fintech or brokerage data: account opening and KYC, funding and transfers, trades a

description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

 You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

 - Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

 - Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

 - Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

 - Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

 - Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

 - Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

 - Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

 - Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

 - Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

 - Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

 - Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

 - Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

 - Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

 - Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

 - Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

 - Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

 - Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

 - Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

 - Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.
   
   


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

 - People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

 - Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

 - Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

 - Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

 - People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

 - Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.
   
   


THE BAR

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights. 

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it. 

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

 - Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

 - Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

 - Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

 - Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

 - Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

 - Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

 - Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

 You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

 - Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

 - Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

 - Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

 - Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

 - Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

 - Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

 - Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

 - Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

 - Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

 - Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

 - Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

 - Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

 - Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

 - Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

 - Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

 - Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

 - Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

 - Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

 - Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

 - Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

 - People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

 - Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

 - Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

 - Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

 - People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

 - Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.




LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.




LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Join Coalition’s Threat Intelligence team to identify emerging vulnerabilities and exploitation activity before they cause loss for policyholders. • Maintain and expand the distributed honeypot network, analyzing telemetry for exploitation and new adversary techniques
• Improve detection accuracy and reduce false positives using claims insights, external datasets, and vulnerability research
• Publish advisories, research, and briefings that inform security decisions
• Participate in the on-call rotation for emergency notifications

• 5+ years in threat intelligence, vulnerability research, pen testing, or defensive security engineering
• Deep knowledge of network protocols, operating systems, web apps, and exploitation (RCE, auth bypass, edge-device vulnerabilities)

• Hands-on experience writing scanner detections, signatures, or parsing scripts (Python, regex, protocol fingerprints)
• Experience with honeypots, deception tech, or internet-wide scanning and other large security datasets
• Strong Python and SQL skills
• Excellent communication with both technical and non-technical audiences
• A track record of clear documentation or public security writing, plus the judgment to lead complex work independently

• Experience with Censys, Shodan, BinaryEdge, or attack surface mapping
• Reverse engineering, patch diffing, or PoC exploit verification
• Familiarity with VPNs, firewalls, load balancers, or SCADA/ICS
• Public research, CVE credits, or conference talks
• Knowledge of cyber insurance, underwriting, or risk aggregation modeling
Perks
• 100% medical, dental and vision coverage

• Mental & physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)!

description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

 You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

 - Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

 - Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

 - Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

 - Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

 - Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

 - Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

 - Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

 - Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

 - Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

 - Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

 - Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

 - Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

 - Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

 - Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

 - Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

 - Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

 - Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

 - Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

 - Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.
   
   


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

 - People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

 - Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

 - Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

 - Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

 - People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

 - Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.
   
   


THE BAR

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights. 

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it. 

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.




LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.




LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:
THE ROLE

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region. 



This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships. 



You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

 - Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

 - Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

 - Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

 - Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

 - Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

 - Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

 - Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

 - Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

 - Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

 - Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

 - Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

 - Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

 - Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

 - Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

 - Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

 - Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

 - Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

 - Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

 - Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.




THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

 - Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

 - Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

 - Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

 - People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

 - Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.




THE BAR

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.



A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.



You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.




LOCATION 

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 



Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.




LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

 3. CEO / final round



For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

 You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

 - Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

 - Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

 - Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

 - Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

 - Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

 - Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

 - Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

 - Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

 - Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

 - Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

 - Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

 - Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

 - Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

 - Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

 - Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

 - Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

 - Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

 - Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

 - Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.
   
   


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

 - People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

 - Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

 - Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

 - Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

 - People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

 - Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.
   
   


THE BAR

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights. 

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it. 

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.




LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.




LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:
THE ROLE

BJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Technical Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

 - Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

 - Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

 - Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

 - Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

 - Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

 - Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

 

What We're Looking For

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

 - Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

 - Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

 - Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

 - Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

 - Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

 


LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.




THE ROLE

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region. 



This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships. 



You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

 - Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

 - Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

 - Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

 - Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

 - Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

 - Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

 - Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

 - Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

 - Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

 - Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

 - Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

 - Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

 - Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

 - Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

 - Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

 - Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

 - Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

 - Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

 - Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.




THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

 - Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

 - Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

 - Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

 - People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

 - Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.




THE BAR

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.



A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.



You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.




LOCATION 

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 



Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.




LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

 3. CEO / final round

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.




THE ROLE

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region. 



This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships. 



You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

 - Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

 - Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

 - Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

 - Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

 - Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

 - Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

 - Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

 - Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

 - Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

 - Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

 - Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

 - Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

 - Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

 - Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

 - Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

 - Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

 - Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

 - Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

 - Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

 You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

 - Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

 - Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

 - Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

 - Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

 - Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

 - Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

 - Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

 - Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

 - Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

 - Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

 - Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

 - Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

 - Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

 - Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

 - Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

 - Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

 - Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

 - Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

 - Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.
   
   


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

 - People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

 - Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

 - Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

 - Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

 - People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

 - Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region. 



This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships. 



You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

description:
Who We Are:
Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.
Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.
Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.
Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.
Our Team Members:
We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!
We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.
About the Role
As a Senior Full Stack Engineer on the Platform Team, you will develop and operate Alpaca’s authentication, authorization, and Identity Provider (IdP) systems - the systems that handle user login, access control, and secure access across our APIs, customer products, and internal tools.
We are looking for experienced engineers who are comfortable owning services end to end: API design, data modeling, deployments, and production debugging. Most of your time will be spent writing Go (backend services, gRPC/REST APIs, shared client libraries), with meaningful work in React/TypeScript for auth-related UI, and occasionally Java for identity-provider extensions. You will also work with Helm charts, analyze logs and metrics, manage deployments, and help other teams to integrate with our services.
Things You Get To Do
• Build and improve authentication-related experiences in customer and partner web applications, including login, permissions, and credential management.
• Develop and maintain the platform’s authentication, authorization, and IdP services.
• Create and evolve shared libraries and SDKs.
• Integrate with identity providers and keep login and access policies working reliably across products.
• Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot identity services in production.
• Help modernize legacy authentication patterns as the platform evolves.
• Own work end to end, from requirements through delivery and follow-up.
• Collaborate with other engineering teams on identity and access integration.
• Maintain high code quality, write tests, and participate in code reviews.
• Help investigate incidents and bugs, including on-call rotation.
Who You Are (must-haves)
• You have 5+ years of experience writing code in strongly-typed languages, with at least one year of experience in Go .
• You have experience building web applications with React and TypeScript .
• You have worked with relational databases before - we use PostgreSQL , but we are not particularly picky about this one as long as you have a solid grasp on the fundamentals.
• You have worked at a startup before - you thrive in ambiguous environments, embrace changing priorities, know when to balance technical debt with speed, and proactively tackle whatever needs to get done without relying on pre-existing processes or documentation.
• You are not afraid of taking a task from start to finish - gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results.
• You have worked at least 3 years on systems at scale .
Who You Might Be (nice-to-haves)
• You know what a JWT token is, and how OpenID Connect and SAML work. Maybe you even heard about Keycloak , or have worked on authentication systems before.
• You have experience with role-based access control .
• You have built or maintained OpenAPI-driven HTTP APIs.
• You are familiar with Kubernetes and Helm .
• You have experience with Java .
• You understand how Kafka works - maybe you even worked with Redpanda before.
• You have experience with Grafana ’s observability stack - Prometheus , Tempo and all the rest. You might have even written a PromQL query for a new alert once or twice.
How We Take Care of You:
• Competitive Salary & Stock Options
• Health Benefits
• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card
Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.
Recruitment Privacy Policy
