description:
About SingleStore
SingleStore delivers a real-time, distributed SQL database that unifies transactional and analytical workloads. Our engineers build cloud-native software for some of the world’s most demanding data-intensive applications, working in a fast-moving environment where teams own their work end to end and partner closely across Product and customer-facing organisations.
About the Flow team
SingleStore Flow is an enterprise data migration and integration product that helps customers move data into SingleStore reliably and at scale. The team builds the systems that support schema transfer, bulk data loading, real-time Change Data Capture (CDC), large-table migrations, and a native experience in SingleStore Helios.
Flow spans Java-based engines, source and destination connectors, database internals, performance and memory management, Helios services and APIs, observability, test automation, Flow AI Agent and signed production release delivery. The product works across heterogeneous database environments, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB, SAP HANA, Snowflake, Salesforce, and SingleStore-as-a-source.
Position Overview
We are looking for a Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership for Flow’s end-to-end data path from source systems and CDC through migration engines, APIs, Helios, and the customer experience.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad technical influence. You will own major architectural decisions, lead strategically important and release-defining initiatives, solve complex reliability and data-consistency problems, and help the team build durable systems that customers can trust with their most important migrations. You will remain close to the code while raising the technical bar for design, testing, observability, operational excellence, and AI-assisted engineering.
The ideal candidate is a systems-minded engineer who enjoys working across product boundaries, can move comfortably between architecture and implementation, and knows how to turn difficult customer problems into scalable product improvements.
What you’ll do
•
Set technical direction for significant areas of Flow, including the migration engines, CDC pipeline, schema evolution, large-table migration, source-to-target data correctness, Flow APIs, Helios integration, and agent-assisted migration workflows.
•
Lead the design and delivery of large, complex, release-defining projects from problem definition through production rollout.
•
Make pragmatic architecture and build-versus-defer decisions that balance customer value, reliability, performance, maintainability, and delivery speed.
•
Design and implement production-quality software while remaining hands-on in the codebase.
•
Solve difficult, ambiguous problems involving data consistency, replication, schema drift, throughput, memory use, concurrency, failure recovery, and backward compatibility.
•
Establish a high bar for technical design, code quality, testing, observability, security, and operational readiness.
•
Drive root-cause analysis for customer-impacting issues and ensure that incidents result in durable fixes, better tests, improved diagnostics, or clearer operational safeguards.
•
Improve the team’s ability to operate Flow in production through runbooks, dashboards, release discipline, incident response, and shared ownership of service health.
•
Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Support, Solutions, and customers to translate real-world migration requirements into robust technical solutions.
•
Mentor engineers, lead design and code reviews, distribute technical context, and help develop the next generation of technical leaders.
•
Create clear technical documentation that makes architecture, APIs, customer journeys, trade-offs, and operational procedures understandable to the broader engineering organization.
•
Advance AI-native development practices and agentic capabilities that improve engineering productivity and make customer migrations more self-serve.
Required skills and experience
•
Significant professional experience building and operating production software, typically 10+ years, or equivalent depth of experience and impact.
•
Expert-level experience with Java including the ability to debug and improve complex, long-lived enterprise-grade codebases.
•
Experience using JDBC with one or more databases, including working with SQL metadata, SQL datatypes, schema information, database-specific behavior, connection pooling, SQL execution, Apache Avro, Protocol Buffers, or similar serialization and integration technologies.
•
Strong understanding of databases and data-intensive systems, including transactions, replication, indexing, connection management, and data consistency.
•
Deep experience with MySQL and PostgreSQL
•
Experience with Java performance engineering, including concurrency, thread pools, garbage collection, memory pressure, or back-pressure
•
Hands-on experience with Change Data Capture or comparable streaming and replication technologies, such as database logs, logical replication, change tracking, checkpoints, or offsets.
•
Demonstrated experience designing reliable, scalable distributed systems where correctness, performance, and availability matter.
•
Experience with cloud-native services and container orchestration, preferably Kubernetes.
•
Track record of leading large technical initiatives and making architecture decisions across team or functional-area boundaries.
•
Strong testing discipline, including unit, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and failure-mode testing.
•
Experience investigating production issues, writing root-cause analyses, and converting operational learnings into engineering improvements.
•
Experience with observability, profiling, metrics, distributed tracing, and production dashboards.

description:
About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid)
About the Department
Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.
About the Team
We build the products that enable the next era of the Internet: making domains Readable , Discoverable , and Callable for autonomous AI agents.
Here at Cloudflare, agentic discovery is a core part of our vision for the Agentic Internet . As AI agents change how humans and machines find, evaluate, and act on information, businesses need tools to control how they are represented and reached. We build capabilities that enable website owners to prepare their sites for agent interaction, test and observe how agents read their content, establish open interaction standards (like WebMCP and MCP), and create entirely new channels to reach agentic audiences.
We are a cross functional group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to serve as a technical anchor and become a subject matter expert on our Agentic Discovery team. In this role, you will define the architecture, core protocols, and multi-team standards powering the next generation of agent-web interactions.
As a senior technical leader, you will shape product roadmaps, mentor engineers across Cloudflare, and write technical specifications that drive execution across multiple teams. You will drive engineering excellence across edge infrastructure, data pipelines, protocol layers, and developer tooling, ensuring systems are resilient and complexity is reduced for your peers.
What You'll Do
• Architect and ship high-throughput, resilient production services that make web properties Readable (structured content transformation), Discoverable (indexing and AEO), and Callable (WebMCP, tool-calling APIs, Generative UI) for autonomous agents.
• Define emerging agent protocols and integrations (MCP, MCP Apps, UCP, MPP, WebMCP). Author architectural specifications and technical designs that guide engineering work both within and outside the ETI team.
• Partner directly with Product Management, customers and stakeholders to translate customer needs into technical requirements, clarify KPIs, and shape engineering roadmaps.
• Drive improvements in system health and observability. Lead complex incident responses, conduct post-incident retrospectives, and rearchitect systems to eliminate failure modes and minimize customer-escalation issues.
• Elevate the engineering process across Cloudflare through code reviews, technical mentorship, architectural governance, and candidate evaluation for engineering hiring.
Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience
• Experience designing scalable system architecture and setting performance metrics in a distributed environment.
• Experience writing technical specifications and leading cross-functional technical initiatives to completion.
• Deep understanding of HTTP, APIs, proxies, caching, web security, and performance bottlenecks spanning multi-service architectures.
• Hands-on experience and deep conceptual understanding of AI agents, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or agent harnesses.
• Ability to partner with product managers and customers to navigate ambiguous problem spaces and iteratively deliver large-scale architecture.
• Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers, contributing to hiring, and driving improvements to engineering processes and incident response workflows.
Bonus Points
• Fluency in async Rust or TypeScript/JavaScript edge runtimes (e.g., Cloudflare Workers) at scale.
• Active contributions to or leadership in open-source agent frameworks, protocols (e.g., MCP), web standards bodies, browser engines, or network proxies.
• Track record of resolving complex, multi-team production incidents and driving post-mortem recommendations to completion.
• Background in search engines, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), web crawling at scale, or RAG p

Who are we?
Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.
We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.
Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.
Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.
We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.
Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.
Role Overview
Join Tripledot Studios' central AI team to help build a game event data hub, bringing together data from multiple studios. This is a new senior role, with an initial focus on data ingestion, preparation and quality: making sure the team knows the health of its data assets and can alert the right people when something fails.
You'll work primarily within the central AI team, coordinating with studio data engineers through their points of contact so that the solutions you build align with their teams' patterns. Over time, you'll rotate into other areas of the team's work, including productionizing and maintaining machine learning pipelines.
Key Responsibilities
• Help build the game event data hub and ingest data from multiple studios.
• Develop and orchestrate data ingestion, preparation, quality checks and backfills.
• Centralize dataset metadata and data quality information using tools such as OpenMetadata, giving the team visibility into the health of its data assets.
• Improve monitoring and notifications so teams know when pipelines or data assets need attention.
• Coordinate changes with studio data engineers to keep shared solutions aligned with their needs and patterns.
• Contribute to productionizing machine learning pipelines, monitoring them and making fixes as you rotate across the team's responsibilities.
Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
• Experience building and operating data pipelines, including ingestion, preparation, data quality checks, backfills and orchestration.
• Working knowledge of Kubernetes, Airflow, SQL and Spark.
• A practical approach to delivering work, with reliability and consistency in how you maintain systems and work with others.
• The ability to collaborate constructively with engineers within your team and across studios.
Nice to have
• Experience in the games industry. It's a plus, not a requirement; we can help you learn the domain if you bring the right technical knowledge.

• Exposure to machine learning workflows.
• Knowledge of Kubeflow.

description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for back-end engineers to expand the functionality of our system. There is flexibility in staffing engineers on projects across the company, depending on the project, your specific responsibilities might include:  

 - Building and maintaining our platform on top of our cutting-edge voice models, which are used by millions of users.

 - Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break-throughs. This could involve adding significant functionality, or building integrations with other common consumer/enterprise solutions.

 - Maintaining and strengthening our internal infrastructure as we scale and grow to ensure that our products remain live, performant and secure.

 - Collaborating closely with engineers and others from the Frontend, Growth and Sales teams to understand, and design solutions for our customers.




REQUIREMENTS

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, or GitHub contributions. We do require:

 - Expertise in Python.

 - A strong background in backend development.

 - Familiarity with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions, data structures etc.

 - Knowledge about test design and security fundamentals.

 - Bonus:
   
   - Experience with Kubernetes.
   
   - Experience with Stripe or other payment processing providers.
   
   - Basics about how AI models work.
     
     


LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

description:
About us
GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.
We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.
Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.
The role
Payment Success helps merchants get paid and keep their cash flow reliable. We predict which payments are likely to fail, recover the money when they do, and protect merchant cash flow across our payment rails.
As Engineering Manager, you will lead a cross-functional team of engineers, a designer and data scientists, building intelligent products that use machine learning and AI.
You will take ownership of the payment intelligence products we have already built, and work with your team and product manager to decide what we build next. We give teams problems to solve rather than tasks to complete, so you and your team will own what gets built, how it gets built and how success is measured.
You will be accountable for the quality, delivery and operation of everything the team ships, and you will look after your people through 1:1s, feedback and career development. You'll step in wherever the team needs you, and earn credibility with senior engineers and data scientists within the team and across product development.
What excites you
• Shipping stuff: you’ll work with your team to support changes to completion, delivering consistent positive impact across your product area. Being comfortable delivering a range of projects: from MVP experiments testing a hypothesis to a new feature
• Developing talent: You hire and grow engineers into being the best engineers they can be, while maintaining a supportive and engaging team culture
• Raising the technical bar: You insist on high standards of technical design and implementation and ensure your systems are operationally excellent
• Deliver project work while managing the expectations of your stakeholders
• Plan and prioritise impactful technical investment initiatives for your teams
• Be a reflection of the GC Values that help us work with one another effectively
What excites us
• Professional experienced in coding - with Python and Ruby on Rails for backend and JavaScript/React on frontend, and a commitment to building reliable, well-tested systems
• Enthusiastic about working in a strong culture of experimentation , testing and learning - to help us in experimenting ways to grow our product!
• Someone excited about supporting and growing a group of engineers, helping them become the best engineers they can be
• Somebody able to effectively communicate - mainly technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences
• Collaboration and cross-functional work - we have a Product Manager, Designer and Data Scientists as part of our team and work with a lot of other commercial teams across the business
• High agency: We’re after people who aren’t afraid of a challenge and will take ownership of problems they come across, help to resolve them and adapt to a constantly changing environment
Base salary range: £ 101,600 - £152,400
Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.
(some of) The good stuff
• Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
• Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period
• Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
• Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
• Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget
• Time off - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)
Life at GoCardless
We're an organisation defined by our values ; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We make it happen , working with urgency and taking personal accountability for getting things done. We act with integrity , always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Our Values form part of the GoCardless DNA, and are used to not only help us nurture and develop our culture, but to deliver impactful work that will help us to achieve our vision.
Diversity & Inclusion
As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.

description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Engineer, you'll be a key player in our engineering organisation, a vibrant community of talented engineers spanning backend, frontend, mobile, and platform disciplines. This isn't just about maintaining; it's about innovating. You'll dive into a wide range of exciting projects, from building and integrating new APIs that elevate the customer journey to optimising our cutting-edge lending platforms. You'll also engage in deep architectural discussions, shaping the future of our products. There's ample opportunity to grow, contribute, and truly make your mark.

 


OUR MODERN TECH STACK

We believe in using the right tools for the job, and our stack reflects our commitment to modern, efficient development:

 - Backend: PHP 8, Symfony, AWS, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes

 - CI/CD: GitHub Actions and ArgoCD (we deploy to production as soon as a feature is complete!)

 - Testing: Behat, PHPUnit for robust automated testing




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're seeking passionate engineers who are excited to contribute and grow with us:

description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a backend-leaning full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.

The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team shaping its capabilities and architecture, with ownership from backend systems and agent infrastructure through to the customer-facing experience. You will help discover what works, turn experiments into reliable features, and use real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include:

 - Building production agents and expanding their capabilities through prompts, tool use, orchestration, new models and MCP integrations.

 - Designing and operating reliable backend systems for asynchronous creative generation and long-running tasks, with strong performance, observability, scalability and security.

 - Developing shared evaluations and live quality monitoring, including model-based assessment of image and video outputs.

 - Owning features end to end, from identifying user needs and prototyping to shipping across the stack and supporting them in production, alongside product, design and engineering.

You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving and operating a live product.




REQUIREMENTS

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.

We are looking for:

 - Strong backend engineering skills, experience operating production systems, and sound fundamentals in APIs, cloud infrastructure, storage and asynchronous processing.

 - Hands-on experience developing agents, with an understanding of prompts, tools, execution logic, evaluations and the challenges of reliable, secure operation.

 - Evidence of independent, end-to-end ownership and confidence working across the stack, including frontend delivery when needed.

 - Good product judgement, clear communication and enthusiasm for creative agents.

We may also consider exceptional engineers with closely relevant experience. Familiarity with HTTP, WebSockets and asynchronous workers will help you build reliable communication between services and recover from failures.

Experience with multimodal generation, creative editors, MCP, or building products in a small, fast-moving team would be particularly valuable.

Location:

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

description:
Be Part of Building the Future
Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost. Learn more at www.dremio.com.
About the role
Dremio's Connectivity team builds the high-performance connectivity solutions that help customers bring data to Dremio and connect Dremio to the broader data ecosystem. The team works across client drivers, protocols, connectors, interoperability, distributed systems, and the reliability and supportability of production data access.
As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll independently own multiple medium-to-large features or service components within a Connectivity and Clients area. You'll define the approach for a substantial team-area scope, turn ambiguous goals into clear milestones, make sound feature and service-level design decisions, and drive work through reliable production delivery. You will bring deep expertise in at least one area, such as JDBC or ODBC drivers, Apache Arrow ADBC, Arrow Flight SQL, BI interoperability, source connectivity, or connectivity reliability, while contributing effectively across adjacent areas. You will also mentor engineers and influence partner teams through strong technical judgment and execution.
What you'll be doing
• Own substantial connectivity work: Lead multiple medium-to-large features or service components from problem definition through design, implementation, validation, release readiness, and operational handoff.
• Turn ambiguity into an execution plan: Define reviewable milestones, acceptance measures, dependencies, estimates, and risks for complex customer, product, and engineering goals.
• Design scalable, maintainable systems: Produce technical designs and architecture diagrams, explain trade-offs, and make feature and service-level decisions across drivers, protocols, client libraries, connectors, and distributed services.
• Diagnose complex failures: Lead root-cause analysis across client/server, protocol, network, authentication, metadata, and distributed-system boundaries using logs, telemetry, profiles, benchmarks, and production evidence.
• Build compatibility and reliability: Maintain API and protocol stability; create automated compatibility, interoperability, performance, scale, reliability, observability, and diagnostics coverage; and define practical migration paths for supported and legacy clients.
• Collaborate and influence: Partner with Product, Query Execution, QA, Support, SRE, Documentation, and external technology partners to resolve dependencies and improve certification, customer experience, and supportability.
• Raise the engineering bar: Participate actively in code and design reviews, mentor and coach engineers, improve team practices, and contribute to relevant upstream open-source projects when aligned with Dremio priorities.
• Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly: Apply Dremio-approved AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, and documentation while protecting proprietary and customer data and validating results through review, testing, and sound engineering judgment.
What we're looking for
• Staff-level ownership: 8+ years of production software engineering experience, or equivalent depth demonstrated through sustained ownership of complex systems and multiple substantial team-area features.
• Programming expertise: Deep proficiency in Java, C++, Rust, Go, or another systems or services language, with the ability to work effectively in adjacent languages and frameworks.
• Connectivity and systems depth: Experience designing and debugging APIs, protocols, client libraries, drivers, or distributed services, with strong knowledge of data structures, concurrency, asynchronous programming, networking, and failure handling.
• Problem-solving ability: Able to identify and solve non-obvious problems across client/server and distributed-system boundaries and turn findings into durable fixes and regression coverage.
• Quality mindset: Experience building comprehensive unit, integration, compatibility, performance, or reliability tests and working with production CI/CD, packaging, release, certification, and engineering quality controls.
• Communication and influence: Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs, surface risks early, align contributors across teams, and influence without formal authority.
• Mentorship: Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach engineers and improve the effectiveness and engineering practices of the team around you.
• Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees and equivalent industry experience are welcomed.
Bonus points if you have
• Experience developing JDBC, ODBC, ADBC, or other database drivers.
• Experience with Apache Arrow or Arrow Flight SQL.
• Experience with SQL engines, databases, data platforms, or source connectors.
• BI interoperability experience with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools, including collaboration with partner engineering teams.
• Knowledge of OAuth, OIDC, TLS, enterprise authentication, metadata discovery, or query pushdown.
• Cross-platform native build, packaging, release engineering, compatibility certification, or upgrade support experience.
• Observability, production diagnostics, customer escalation, long-running data transfer, cancellation, keepalive, timeout, or proxy experience.
• Contributions to Apache Arrow or other relevant open-source projects

Life at Riskified
We are a fast-growing and dynamic tech company with 750+ team members globally. We value collaboration and innovative thinking.
We’re looking for bright, driven, and passionate people

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority.  We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.
The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.
 
Tala is seeking a driven engineer to join our growing Product Development team. The ideal candidate is adept at problem-solving and debugging, and is committed to continuously improving existing systems and processes. You will work closely with fellow Tala engineers to build and extend Tala's backend architecture to support new country launches, new features, and a fast growing user base.
 
The Senior Backend Engineer owns systems and initiatives that span a domain. You set your own technical approach, need minimal technical guidance, and raise the domain's quality bar through design, review, and partnership with peers. As a technologist and a leader, you push the team toward a highly available, scalable, reliable, fault tolerant, and performant microservices platform. You follow and improve Tala's engineering processes and standards while advancing Tala's mission and business objectives.
This is a technical leadership role within Tala's technical track, set in a supportive team environment with significant opportunities for career advancement and professional development. You will collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the globe.
 
 

Key Responsibilities
Design and Engineering
•
Design, develop, and maintain backend services, APIs, and data integration layers that power key product features.
•
Author design documents (EDDs) for services in the domain and defend them in review.
•
Design and optimize database schemas and queries for performance and system reliability.
•
Meet project goals without trading away quality, and pay down technical debt as part of delivery rather than as a separate request.
•
Serve as the go-to person for one or more technologies in the domain, following industry developments and explaining concretely how they would or would not apply at Tala.
Quality, Review, and Standards
•
Hold the domain's engineering bar in code and design reviews, including for work from other technical teams.
•
Write clean, maintainable code that follows established coding standards.
•
Contribute to the testing infrastructure to increase coverage for backend modules.
•
Verify AI-assisted changes to the same standard as hand-written code.
Reliability and Operations
•
Define alerting, SLIs, and SLOs, and advance monitoring of backend modules so availability and response times improve proactively.
•
Handle incidents that the runbook does not cover, fill runbook gaps found during a shift, lead the technical response for domain incidents, and write the RCA.
•
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues quickly across development and production environments.
Delivery and Collaboration
•
Own delivery of domain roadmap work and take part in quarterly and sprint planning with a view on feasibility.
•
Anticipate blockers before sprint commitment, and escalate with a problem statement, an impact assessment, and proposed options.
•
Work with Product and business stakeholders to remove ambiguity and to understand what success means for a feature.
•
Work with the team lead to deliver domain solutions, and own service design and implementation end to end, including regressions you introduce.
•
Keep the domain's tickets accurate and its documentation complete enough that it is the first place people look.
•
Work across multiple time zones using asynchronous communication.
Mentorship
•
Act as a dedicated mentor to junior and mid-level engineers, with a clear sense of what each is working to improve.
•
Technically lead and mentor a team of Backend Engineers building or extending complex modules.
Required Skills and Experience
•
Language: Fluency in English, including clear written communication, which is how most work happens across time zones.
•
Backend engineering: Hands-on experience designing, building, and operating applications in Java, Kotlin, and/or Scala, including a web framework such as Spring.
•
Track record: Has led and delivered multiple domain-significant projects, each validated in production over a meaningful period, including large scale consumer applications on cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) using microservices architecture.
•
Technical expertise: Subject-matter expert in their own domain and conversant in adjacent ones. Maintains a working mental model of the wider company architecture and where the seams are. Assesses code and design quality beyond their own area.
•
Solution building and system design: Designs services and their dependencies with security, maintainability, operability, and scale accounted for. Authors design documents (EDDs) and defend them in review. Designs for failure cases, not just the happy path.
•
API design: Expert knowledge of REST API design and development for mobile and web use.
•
Judgment and problem framing: Reframes poorly posed problems instead of answering them as asked. Decides with incomplete information and states the assumptions relied on. Distinguishes reversible from irreversible decisions and applies rigor accordingly. Choose the smallest solution that solves the problem.
•
Data stores: Strong relational database experience (MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MS SQL) and strong non-relational database experience (Cassandra, Redshift, DynamoDB, or HDFS).

By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from Booking.com , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.
Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.
About the role
Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona, Palma, Dublin, or Casablanca.
Own the backend of a white-label travel platform as it adds new verticals.
Hotels and flights are live. Experiences launch within weeks, and car rentals and more payment providers come next. Our clients are travel brands, banks, and influencers, so every launch brings a new challenge and a chance to design it properly.You'll step in as the backend owner at a pivotal moment. You'll shape the architecture, lead the integrations for each new vertical, and stay hands-on in the code. We've moved quickly to get here, so there's real room to set the standards and clean up the foundations as we grow.This is a role with real ownership. You'll work directly with the backend lead, and within about six months you'll be making the backend decisions yourself.
What makes it interesting for you:
• You get real technical authority. You become the primary backend decision-maker for a product line, working directly with the backend lead and engineering leadership. Your architecture choices stay in the product, and the role has room to grow as the platform and team expand.
• You build on a product that is still taking shape. The platform is heading toward Shopify-level customization, with modular components and configurations for very different clients. You'll build foundations that later verticals depend on.
• You get variety. Each client brings an odd requirement, and the good ideas often become features for other clients. You'll learn something new most weeks.
• You join a stable team. The team has worked together for two to three years, and the engineers look out for each other.
Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre.
The kind of problems you’ll work on:
• How do we design the backend so that adding a vertical, such as experiences or car rentals, doesn't mean rebuilding what already works?
• Which pieces of existing technical debt hold back reliability or delivery speed, and what is the cleanest order to fix them while shipping?
• How do we integrate third-party travel APIs and payment providers so that bookings stay reliable when a supplier is slow or fails?
• How should our schedulers, cron jobs, and workers be built so they stay dependable as traffic grows?
• How do we keep AWS infrastructure performing for client launches without over-engineering it?
You’ll work on problems where the product, technical approach, and best path forward are still being figured out.
The role is backend-heavy and product-driven. You should be comfortable going from idea to design, implementation, and real usage, without needing detailed specs.
A good way to think of it is: you build the first version that proves something works.
This role fits if you:
• Have 4 to 5 years in backend engineering, including at least 2 years of full-time Node.js and TypeScript in production. Java or Python backgrounds are welcome if you have since worked in Node full time.
• Have designed REST APIs and relational schemas in PostgreSQL.
• Have worked with background jobs, schedulers, or workers that talk to third-party systems.
• Have roughly two years of hands-on AWS, enough to run a product that has to handle real traffic.
• Have taken ownership of a product's outcomes beyond the tickets assigned to you, and stepped in when a teammate was out.
• Have experience leading technical decisions for a team, or have been in a position to. You still write code every day.
Nuitée is fast-moving, low on process, and high on ownership. This suits people who are comfortable with ambiguity, pace, and responsibility. It is less suited to people who prefer structured environments and clearly defined scope from day one.
Travel experience helps but is not required. Experience in a fast-moving product company probably is.
We move quickly and have little process. You'll see 10 plus features moving in parallel, and priorities can change when a client needs something.
You'll contribute code in your first days and take decisions with incomplete information. The first couple of weeks are about getting used to this rhythm, and after that you have a lot of autonomy.
If that resonates, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2 to 3 weeks.

At Nuitée, we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.

description:
About us
GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.
We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.
Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.
The role
You will be joining our Solution Engineering team and will be the primary technical lead during engagements with our prospective and existing merchants. You will help qualify, shape, close and support new and existing business opportunities. You will provide technical guidance and oversight on our most exciting opportunities whilst working alongside our sales teams.
Your day-to-day will focus on:
• Working with our sales team on new and existing opportunities
• Presenting and crafting demos showcasing our product
• Performing technical discovery and architecting solution designs for prospects
• Work closely with our product team on product improvements, new initiatives and feature requests
• Work alongside implementation managers and customer success teams to ensure a smooth journey for clients
What excites you
• You are a problem solver at heart
• You have a love for learning and are curious by nature
• You are consultative and love to get stuck into the detail
• You have a growth mindset and are open to new lines of thought
• You love to help clients accelerate their growth and build innovative experiences
What excites us
• Experience as a pre-sales or post-sales solution engineer
• Ability to articulate complex technical solutions to non-technical audiences
• Ability to work with API tools such as Postman and debugging/logging tools
• Experience in building integrations with Payment-Service Providers
• A deep understanding of how APIs function
• Programming skills in at least one common programming language
• A compelling storyteller
Base salary range: £48,800 – £73,200 + 30% OTE.
Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.
(some of) The good stuff
• Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
• Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period
• Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
• Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
• Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget
• Time off - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)
Life at GoCardless
We're an organisation defined by our values ; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We make it happen , working with urgency and taking personal accountability for getting things done. We act with integrity , always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Our Values form part of the GoCardless DNA, and are used to not only help us nurture and develop our culture, but to deliver impactful work that will help us to achieve our vision.
Diversity & Inclusion
As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.
To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024). With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:
Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — 25%
Neurodiverse — 9%
LGBTQIA+ — 9%
Disabled — 1%
Average age — 33
Female — 45%
Male — 55%
We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make our recruitment process as remarkable and accessible as we can. Please speak to your Talent Partner if you need extra support.
If you want to learn more, you can read about our Employee Resource Groups and objectives here
Sustainability
We’re committed to reducing our impact on the environment, leaving a more sustainable world for future generations. Check out our sustainability action plan here.

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Pragmatike is hiring on behalf of a fast-growing GPU compute and cloud infrastructure company serving enterprise customers running demanding AI and compute workloads.

As the Senior Solutions Engineer, you will own the technical side of enterprise customer relationships from pre-sales through onboarding and ongoing production usage.

You will work closely with enterprise customers, account managers, product and infrastructure teams to make sure customers can successfully deploy, run and scale their workloads.

This is a highly autonomous, hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and taking full ownership of the customer experience.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own enterprise customer onboarding: manage access, networking, storage, server handover and first workloads through to production.

 - Act as the first technical point of contact for enterprise customers, understanding and troubleshooting issues before escalating to SRE or engineering when needed.

 - Own technical issues through resolution: provide context to internal teams, coordinate communication and ensure issues are closed properly.

 - Support pre-sales activities: lead technical discovery, solution design, sizing, demos and POCs alongside the commercial team.

 - Design and run POCs with clear technical success criteria and help customers move from evaluation to production.

 - Debug customer workloads hands-on, including inference and multi-GPU workloads, working directly with customer engineering teams.

 - Monitor account health proactively: identify technical risks, communicate incidents and RCAs, track uptime and surface potential issues before they become blockers.

 - Work cross-functionally with Account Management, Product, SRE and Engineering to translate customer requirements into effective technical solutions.

 - Improve the enterprise customer experience by identifying recurring technical problems and creating better onboarding and operational processes.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience as a Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager or similar customer-facing technical role.

 - Experience working with cloud infrastructure, GPU infrastructure, AI infrastructure or enterprise compute.

 - Strong hands-on knowledge of:
   
   - Linux
   
   - Virtual machines
   
   - Kubernetes
   
   - Networking
   
   - Storage
   
   - NVIDIA GPUs

 - Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure and AI workloads alongside experienced customer engineers.

 - Experience running technical demos, POCs, implementations or enterprise deployments.

 - Strong understanding of production infrastructure and the ability to distinguish between customer-facing issues and underlying SRE/engineering problems.

 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Highly proactive and autonomous: you should be comfortable identifying what needs to happen next without waiting for instructions.

 - Strong ownership mentality. You follow problems through to resolution rather than simply passing them to another team.

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where processes are still being built.

 - Fluent English is a MUST and French is preferrable 




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In this role, you will become the technical owner for a portfolio of enterprise customers.

You will be expected to independently manage customer onboarding, technical discovery, POCs, workload troubleshooting and ongoing account health, while partnering closely with the commercial and infrastructure teams.

The goal is simple: customers should be able to get their workloads running quickly, stay successful in production and have a strong technical partner throughout their journey.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Pricing

description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.




🎯 THE ROLE

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Pricing.

You'll join the Pricing squad, the team behind the pricing engine at the heart of RED, tem's modern utility product. The systems you build price real energy contracts for businesses buying electricity and renewable generators selling it, so correctness shows up as money and speed shows up as trust.

This is a backend, data-heavy engineering role with a quant-y flavour. You'll help build our new Pricing API, make prices fast, accurate and understandable, and make sure that when we can't price something, we can always explain why.

In your first 12 months, you might:

 - Design and ship core slices of our new Pricing API, taking them from first design through to production.

 - Consolidate pricing logic into one service with a clean boundary, keeping pricing behaviour stable throughout the move.

 - Build the detection and alerting that catches bad or slow prices before they ever reach a customer.

 - Give our commercial team self-serve answers to "why can't we price this?".

 - Make pricing measurably faster for every customer quote.


🛠️ RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build with impact: design and ship components of the Pricing API that price real energy contracts, owning work from design through to production.

 - Make it fast: help bring the time to a first customer price down dramatically, without sacrificing accuracy.

 - Own reliability: build the error handling, observability and alerting that make pricing fail loudly and explainably, never silently.

 - Sharpen the boundaries: extract and consolidate pricing logic so the pricing engine owns its own behaviour end-to-end.

 - Close the loop: take your turn handling live pricing questions and incidents, and turn what you learn into structural fixes.


✅ REQUIREMENTS

Must-Haves

 - Production backend Python: you have shipped and run an API in production and been on the hook when it broke.

 - Comfortable with FastAPI and SQL, and with data- and analytics-heavy systems where the correctness of numbers matters.

 - Product engineering nous: you ask what the price is for and who reads it, not just how to compute it.

 - You build with agents: Claude or similar is part of your daily workflow for writing, testing and reviewing code.

 - You can own a project end to end - scoping, delivery, quality - with a tech lead as a sounding board rather than a supervisor.

Desirable

 - Domain knowledge from fintech, energy pricing or neo-utilities, or ad-tech.

 - Experience working inside or alongside machine learning teams.

 - AWS and serverless patterns (Lambda, event-driven services, Postgres on RDS).

 - Polars, or a taste for making numerical code fast.


🎁 BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Competitive salary - our current band for this role is [salary band] or equivalent in local currency.

 - Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

 - 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

 - Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

 - Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup.

 - Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing.


🤝 INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - First call with Jack on our Talent Team (30m)

 - Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager (60 mins)

 - Technical Interview with the Team (75 mins). You'll meet with Engineers, discuss backend engineering for pricing systems, including a practical whiteboard exercise

 - Bar Raiser Interview with Senior stakeholder (45m)



We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: Senior Product Engineer, R&D
locationReason: location lists Portugal/Europe/EMEA/worldwide

description:
About the company
At Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.”
By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology.
With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber.
Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from Booking.com , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.
Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.
About the role
Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona, Palma, Dublin, or Casablanca.
Unique problems to solve: a good fix in the morning can be live in production by the evening, and it will be serving real partner traffic.
Nuitée is hiring Senior Product Engineers to join Connect, the domain at the heart of our platform. Connect is where hotel supply from hundreds of suppliers becomes one clean API that partners build on: how we connect to suppliers, price and serve inventory at scale, and make fragmented travel data usable in real time.
You'll work across the full lifecycle, building new capabilities and scaling the systems partners rely on every day. You'll go from idea to production without detailed specs, and you'll be accountable for whether what you ship creates real value.
The problem is hard: latency, correctness, cost and supplier limits all pull in different directions, and the product decisions can't be separated from the technical ones.
What makes it interesting for you:
• You can move extremely fast. There's very little red tape and teams make their own product decisions. A good idea in the morning can be in production by the evening, and many iterations ship in days rather than months.
• You own the path to the outcome. You'll agree what success looks like, then decide with your team how to get there, including when to say no.
• You get genuinely hard engineering problems. Caching, multi-supplier pricing, data pipelines, and routing under strict latency budgets all interact in real time.
• You'll shape how we build. We got to roughly €1B in booking value with a lean team. Now we're building the next phase of the platform as we push toward €10B, and you'll help set the engineering and product standards
Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre.
The kind of problems you’ll work on:
• How do we take fragmented, inconsistent data from hundreds of suppliers and serve it reliably through a clean API?
• How do we cache and deliver a pricing matrix covering 100k+ hotels so partners can use it in real time?
• How do we answer multi-supplier rate requests within strict latency budgets, route to the best suppliers, and protect supplier QPS and system stability under load?
• How do we harmonize data across suppliers (room mapping, for example), including with LLM-assisted approaches?
You’ll work on problems where the product, technical approach, and best path forward are still being figured out.
The role is backend-heavy and product-driven. You should be comfortable going from idea to design, implementation, and real usage, without needing detailed specs.
A good way to think of it is: you build the first version that proves something works.
This role fits someone who:
• Is a senior and hands-on backend engineer, ideally with experience in Go (but we’re also interested in people from C#, Java, C++ or similar backgrounds who want to pick up Go)
• Has built products or major features from scratch
• Thinks in terms of outcomes and user value, not just implementation
• Is comfortable working without clear specs or structure
• Can make pragmatic tradeoffs and move fast
• Has experience with APIs, data-heavy systems, or distributed environments
• Takes ownership beyond their scope and pushes things forward
Nuitée is fast-moving, low on process, and high on ownership. This suits people who are comfortable with ambiguity, pace, and responsibility. It is less suited to people who prefer structured environments and clearly defined scope from day one.
If that resonates, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2 to 3 weeks.
Why Nuitee?
At Nuitée, we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.
• Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale.
• World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally.
• Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup.
• Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others
• AI-Driven Innovation:

description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values -driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.
The opportunity
At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.
We are proud of:
• The work we do and the innovation we drive
• Our values of share, care a nd dare
• A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
• Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration
The role
We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize modern, cloud-based data platforms that power analytics, AI, and data products. Beyond technical delivery, we want someone genuinely curious about the business problems behind the data, who applies common sense, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help shape business requirements, not just implement them as given.
You will work on scalable batch, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines, delivering high-quality curated datasets with robust governance, security, and observability. You will also support AI and GenAI systems, enabling pipelines for machine learning, causal modeling, and LLM-powered applications such as RAG and agent-based systems, and collaborate closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and platform teams.
Platforms
Our work is centered on AWS with Databricks , with growing demand on GCP , including cloud migration programs. Azure/Fabric experience is also valued. We are looking for engineers with deep expertise in one cloud who are T-shaped: comfortable working across clouds and keen to broaden their platform experience. You’ll be staffed on projects that fit your strongest platform, with opportunities to expand.
Responsibilities
Build & Data Platform Engineering
• Design and implement scalable data platforms and pipelines, primarily on AWS and Databricks, and on GCP or Azure/Fabric where projects require.
• Develop reliable batch, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines using Spark and Delta Lake.
• Build ingestion, transformation, and curation workflows for structured and unstructured data.
• Implement lakehouse patterns and medallion layering (bronze, silver, gold), ensuring reusable, scalable systems aligned with enterprise needs.
• Contribute to cloud-to-cloud migrations, including re-platforming pipelines and data models.
Enable AI, GenAI & Data Products
• Deliver model-ready, production-grade datasets for analytics, ML, causal modeling, and optimization.
• Build data pipelines for GenAI use cases (LLMs, RAG, vector-based data flows) and agent-based architectures.
• Leverage Databricks MLflow and Unity Catalog, or equivalent tooling on other platforms.
Data Modeling, Orchestration & Automation
• Design logical and physical data models for analytical and operational use cases.
• Orchestrate workflows with Databricks Workflows, Airflow, dbt, or equivalents (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Cloud Composer), with a focus on automation, reliability, and maintainability.
Architecture, Governance & Observability
• Apply event-driven and streaming architecture patterns.
• Ensure data governance, lineage, quality, and access control (RBAC/ABAC) using Unity Catalog, AWS Lake Formation, or equivalents (Microsoft Purview, GCP Dataplex).
• Establish observability: data freshness, pipeline reliability, and SLA adherence.
Data Serving, Integration & Optimization
• Enable serving layers (APIs, feature inputs, analytical endpoints) for downstream ML and AI platforms.
• Continuously optimize pipelines and infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost.
Requirements Discovery & Business Partnership
• Ask the right questions to understand not just what stakeholders want, but why.
• Surface gaps and better alternatives rather than executing a brief as written.
Collaboration
• Work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders.
• Support adoption of data products and contribute to best practices.
Must-have qualifications
Technical skills
• Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and Delta Lake.
• Strong Python and SQL.
• Proven experience building batch and streaming pipelines and production-grade data platforms.
